title: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange Count
question:
What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Elementary School District refers to DOC = 52; Unified School District refers to DOC = 54.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.XCL_050 = 'Unified School District' AND s.XCL_049 = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.XCL_050 = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools s
WHERE s.XCL_049 = 'Orange' OR s.XCL_050 = 'Elementary School District'
